lines.x: The U.S. dollar exchange rate in Colombia rose to 3,415.10 pesos on Friday morning, gaining 88.14 pesos from the prior level.
The Colombian peso experienced a rapid depreciation, falling over 5% against the US dollar during the week to trade above 3,500 pesos per dollar.
The US dollar rose by 88 Colombian pesos in a single day to trade at 3,415 pesos, marking its steepest one-day gain since April 2025 and accumulating an increase of 193.91 pesos since November 5.
The Colombian peso slipped past 3,415 per dollar as Wall Street equity declines weighed on emerging market currencies.
